title: Apple Opens a New Route Between Siri AI and Apps

sources.name: Apple Developer
sources.title: Siri AI is now open to all developers

sources.name: Apple Newsroom
sources.title: Siri AI is available in more languages starting today

sources.name: Apple Newsroom
sources.title: Siri AI, a profoundly more capable and personal assistant, is here

paragraphs.en: On November 3, 2026, Apple announced
paragraphs.zh: 2026年11月3日，蘋果宣布

paragraphs.en: that developers could begin trying a new way
paragraphs.zh: 開發者可以開始嘗試一種新方式，

paragraphs.en: to connect their apps with Siri AI.
paragraphs.zh: 讓自己的應用程式與Siri AI連接。

paragraphs.en: The Developer Preview arrived with new beta software,
paragraphs.zh: 這項開發者預覽隨新的測試版軟體推出，

paragraphs.en: including iOS 27.3 and macOS 27.3.
paragraphs.zh: 其中包括iOS 27.3及macOS 27.3。

paragraphs.en: Its purpose is to let more app makers
paragraphs.zh: 其目的是讓更多應用程式開發者

paragraphs.en: offer their content and actions through the assistant.
paragraphs.zh: 透過助理提供程式內容與操作功能。

paragraphs.en: For the industry, this creates another route
paragraphs.zh: 對產業而言，這創造了另一條途徑，

paragraphs.en: through which people might discover and use apps.
paragraphs.zh: 讓人們有機會發現並使用應用程式。

paragraphs.en: The connection uses a framework called App Intents.
paragraphs.zh: 這種連接使用名為App Intents的框架。

paragraphs.en: Developers describe actions their software can perform,
paragraphs.zh: 開發者描述軟體能執行的操作，

paragraphs.en: so the assistant can respond to ordinary requests.
paragraphs.zh: 讓助理能回應日常語言提出的要求。

paragraphs.en: Apple gives examples such as checking a delivery
paragraphs.zh: 蘋果舉的例子包括查詢配送狀態，

paragraphs.en: or making a reservation.
paragraphs.zh: 或預訂服務。

paragraphs.en: It also describes tools for combining several actions
paragraphs.zh: 它也描述了能整合多項操作的工具，

paragraphs.en: into one experience when a request is complex.
paragraphs.zh: 以便在要求較複雜時，串成一次完整的體驗。

paragraphs.en: The underlying app still supplies the supported action.
paragraphs.zh: 底層應用程式仍須提供所支援的操作功能。

paragraphs.en: Apple's earlier September 14 announcement
paragraphs.zh: 蘋果先前於9月14日發布的公告

paragraphs.en: explained the broader idea behind its assistant.
paragraphs.zh: 解釋了這款助理背後更廣泛的構想。

paragraphs.en: Siri AI can use personal context
paragraphs.zh: Siri AI可以運用個人情境，

paragraphs.en: to locate information across messages, emails, and photos.
paragraphs.zh: 跨越訊息、電子郵件與照片尋找資訊。

paragraphs.en: One example involved finding a family recipe
paragraphs.zh: 其中一個例子是找出家人的食譜，

paragraphs.en: and adding ingredients to a shopping list.
paragraphs.zh: 再把食材加入購物清單。

paragraphs.en: The company also described questions about onscreen content.
paragraphs.zh: 該公司也描述了針對螢幕內容提出問題的用法。

paragraphs.en: These examples illustrate Apple's intended experience:
paragraphs.zh: 這些例子呈現了蘋果想提供的體驗：

paragraphs.en: users describe a goal instead of every individual step.
paragraphs.zh: 使用者描述目標，而不是逐一說明每個步驟。

paragraphs.en: Language is another part of the expansion.
paragraphs.zh: 語言是這波擴展的另一個部分。

paragraphs.en: On October 26, Apple announced support
paragraphs.zh: 10月26日，蘋果宣布新增支援

paragraphs.en: for French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish.
paragraphs.zh: 法文、日文、韓文、葡萄牙文及西班牙文。

paragraphs.en: That update followed the initial English release.
paragraphs.zh: 這項更新接續最初的英文版本而來。

paragraphs.en: The same announcement said Traditional Chinese, Norwegian,
paragraphs.zh: 同一份公告表示，繁體中文、挪威文、

paragraphs.en: Turkish, and Vietnamese would follow
paragraphs.zh: 土耳其文及越南文將陸續加入，

paragraphs.en: by the end of 2026.
paragraphs.zh: 預計在2026年底之前提供。

paragraphs.en: Those languages were announced as future additions,
paragraphs.zh: 這些語言當時是以未來新增項目公布的，

paragraphs.en: so readers should distinguish the schedule from current support.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，讀者應區分預定時程與現有支援。

paragraphs.en: Access also depends on hardware and location.
paragraphs.zh: 能否使用也取決於硬體與所在地。

paragraphs.en: Apple says Siri AI requires a device
paragraphs.zh: 蘋果表示，Siri AI需要一部

paragraphs.en: that supports Apple Intelligence, set to a supported language.
paragraphs.zh: 支援Apple Intelligence且設定為支援語言的裝置。

paragraphs.en: Its October availability notes describe the service as beta.
paragraphs.zh: 10月的供應說明將這項服務列為測試版。

paragraphs.en: They also say it is unavailable
paragraphs.zh: 說明也指出，這項服務尚未提供於

paragraphs.en: to European Union users on iOS, iPadOS, and watchOS.
paragraphs.zh: 歐盟地區的iOS、iPadOS與watchOS使用者。

paragraphs.en: That restriction names particular operating systems.
paragraphs.zh: 這項限制指的是特定作業系統。

paragraphs.en: It should not be read as a statement
paragraphs.zh: 讀者不應將其解讀為

paragraphs.en: that every Apple product has identical regional availability.
paragraphs.zh: 每一款蘋果產品的地區供應情況都完全相同。

paragraphs.en: The November preview is aimed at development work.
paragraphs.zh: 11月的預覽版是為開發工作而設。

paragraphs.en: Apple says developers have time to explore,
paragraphs.zh: 蘋果表示，開發者可以利用這段時間探索、

paragraphs.en: build, and provide feedback before wider customer delivery.
paragraphs.zh: 建置並提供回饋，之後才會更廣泛地交付給消費者。

paragraphs.en: It expects App Store submissions for these experiences
paragraphs.zh: 該公司預期，這類體驗的App Store上架申請

paragraphs.en: to open in the following spring.
paragraphs.zh: 將於隔年春季開放。

paragraphs.en: The announcement therefore describes an opportunity to prepare,
paragraphs.zh: 因此，這份公告描述的是準備的機會，

paragraphs.en: not an immediate upgrade for every existing app.
paragraphs.zh: 並非每個既有程式都會立即升級。

paragraphs.en: App makers must still create their integrations.
paragraphs.zh: 應用程式開發者仍須自行建立整合功能。

paragraphs.en: The possible change for users is straightforward.
paragraphs.zh: 對使用者而言，可能出現的改變很直接。

paragraphs.en: A useful app might become accessible
paragraphs.zh: 實用的應用程式可能變得更容易使用，

paragraphs.en: through a spoken request rather than a familiar button.
paragraphs.zh: 人們可以提出口頭要求，而不必透過熟悉的按鈕操作。

paragraphs.en: For developers, that makes the clarity
paragraphs.zh: 對開發者來說，這使得清楚界定

paragraphs.en: of each available action especially important.
paragraphs.zh: 每個可用操作變得特別重要。

paragraphs.en: If these integrations work reliably,
paragraphs.zh: 如果這些整合能可靠運作，

paragraphs.en: they could change how people move between services.
paragraphs.zh: 就可能改變人們在不同服務之間切換的方式。

paragraphs.en: That remains a possibility to evaluate
paragraphs.zh: 這仍是有待評估的可能性，

paragraphs.en: as the preview develops into a wider release.
paragraphs.zh: 必須觀察預覽版走向更廣泛發布的過程。

quiz.question: What is the main purpose of the article?

choices.text: To compare the quarterly revenue of several app makers.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。文章沒有比較應用程式開發者的季度營收；主軸是Siri AI整合預覽及其使用條件。

choices.text: To explain a developer preview that connects app actions with Siri AI.
choices.explanation: 正確。第1、2段介紹開發者預覽和App Intents，第6、7段補充開發時程及可能影響。

choices.text: To announce that every app already works with Siri AI.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第6段明確指出不是每個既有程式都會立即升級，開發者仍須建立整合功能。

choices.text: To teach readers how to install beta software on their phones.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。文章提到測試版作為新聞背景，但沒有提供安裝步驟。

quiz.explanation: 本題考主旨。文章報導11月3日的開發者預覽，解釋它如何讓程式內容與操作連接Siri AI，並說明語言、裝置、地區和開發時程等限制。重點不是營收比較或安裝教學。

evidence.quote: Its purpose is to let more app makers offer their content and actions through the assistant.
The announcement therefore describes an opportunity to prepare, not an immediate upgrade for every existing app. App makers must still create their integrations.

quiz.question: What can be inferred about two users trying the same service?

choices.text: They must have identical access because the assistant has one name.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第5段說能否使用取決於硬體、設定語言與所在地，名稱相同不代表條件相同。

choices.text: They can ignore device compatibility if their apps are installed.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第5段要求裝置支援Apple Intelligence且設定為支援語言，並非安裝程式就可忽略相容性。

choices.text: They may have different access because their devices, languages, or locations differ.
choices.explanation: 正確。第5段明確列出硬體、語言與地區條件，因此兩位使用者的使用情況可能不同。

choices.text: They automatically receive every language announced for the future.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第4段將預定新增語言與現有支援區分，未來項目不會自動成為當前可用功能。

quiz.explanation: 本題考合理推論。相同的服務名稱與應用程式，並不足以保證相同供應情況。裝置能力、語言及所在地都是條件；此外，預定新增的語言也不能直接當成已推出。

evidence.quote: Access also depends on hardware and location. Apple says Siri AI requires a device that supports Apple Intelligence, set to a supported language.
Those languages were announced as future additions, so readers should distinguish the schedule from current support.

quiz.question: Which conclusion best summarizes the possible change described in the article?

choices.text: People may reach app services through requests, while developers still need to build reliable integrations.
choices.explanation: 正確。第7段描述口頭要求成為操作入口的可能性，第6段指出開發者仍須建立整合；兩者合起來才能完整說明變化。

choices.text: Spoken requests remove the need for apps to supply supported actions.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第2段明確指出底層應用程式仍須提供支援的操作功能。

choices.text: The preview proves that every multi-step request will succeed.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第7段以條件句說明可靠整合可能帶來的變化，並未宣稱所有多步驟要求都已驗證成功。

choices.text: The language expansion and developer preview are the same announcement.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第1段的預覽公告日期為11月3日，第4段語言擴展公告日期為10月26日，是不同事件。

quiz.explanation: 本題考整體總結。文章描繪的變化，是使用者可以用自然語言接觸程式服務，而開發者要把可執行操作定義清楚並完成整合。這仍須觀察可靠性和後續發布，不能視為所有功能已自動完成。

evidence.quote: A useful app might become accessible through a spoken request rather than a familiar button. For developers, that makes the clarity of each available action especially important. If these integrations work reliably, they could change how people move between services.
App makers must still create their integrations.
The underlying app still supplies the supported action.
